propositions: The readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are present in the field inventory, allowing a declaration of readiness when the plugin has not yet registered those fields.

A timing flake can occur when the readiness gate returns on serverInfo 200 before GreenHopper provisions custom fields, causing later assertions to fail with a misattributed 'image degrade' instead of a 'not yet ready' diagnosis.

The harness and probe workflows use different readiness definitions (serverInfo polling vs. field inventory polling), creating drift that violates the design constraint that both tiers must share one readiness predicate.

A fresh Jira DC instance with no Software project will expose zero customfield_* entries indefinitely, because GreenHopper provisions Epic fields only when a Software project is created, not during plugin initialization.

The readiness wait must gate on the field inventory containing all names in _REQUIRED_FIELDS before declaring the instance ready, with a bounded budget and self-diagnosing failure message that names the observed inventory.
